<resource methods="POST" uri-template="/transfer">
        <inSequence>
            <variable name="fromAccount" expression="${payload.fromAccount}" type="STRING"/>
            <variable name="toAccount" expression="${payload.toAccount}" type="STRING"/>
            <variable name="amount" expression="${payload.amount}" type="DOUBLE"/>
            
            <filter xpath="${vars.amount > 0}">
                <then>
                    <payloadFactory media-type="json">
                        <format>{
                            "status": "success",
                            "message": "Transfer completed successfully",
                            "transaction": {
                                "transactionId": "TXN${now()}",
                                "fromAccount": "${vars.fromAccount}",
                                "toAccount": "${vars.toAccount}",
                                "amount": ${vars.amount},
                                "timestamp": "${formatDateTime(now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}"
                            }
                        }</format>
                    </payloadFactory>
                    <respond/>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <throwError type="VALIDATION_ERROR" errorMessage="Transfer amount must be greater than zero"/>
                </else>
            </filter>
        </inSequence>
        <faultSequence>
            <log category="ERROR">
                <message>Transfer failed: ${props.synapse.ERROR_MESSAGE}</message>
            </log>
            <payloadFactory media-type="json">
                <format>{
                    "status": "error",
                    "message": "Transfer processing failed"
                }</format>
            </payloadFactory>
            <respond/>
        </faultSequence>
    </resource>

<sequence name="AuthenticationSequence" xmlns="http://ws.apache.org/ns/synapse">
    <filter xpath="${exists(headers.Authorization)}">
        <then>
            <variable name="authHeader" expression="${headers.Authorization}" type="STRING"/>
            <filter xpath="${startsWith(vars.authHeader, 'Bearer ')}">
                <then>
                    <variable name="token" expression="${subString(vars.authHeader, 7)}" type="STRING"/>
                    <log category="INFO">
                        <message>Authentication successful for token: ${vars.token}</message>
                    </log>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <throwError type="AUTH_ERROR" errorMessage="Invalid authorization header format"/>
                </else>
            </filter>
        </then>
        <else>
            <throwError type="AUTH_ERROR" errorMessage="Authorization header missing"/>
        </else>
    </filter>
</sequence>

<template name="GetAccountBalanceTool" xmlns="http://ws.apache.org/ns/synapse">
  <description>Retrieves the current account balance for a given account ID</description>
  <parameter isMandatory="true" name="accountId" description="The account ID to check balance for"/>
  <sequence>
    <payloadFactory media-type="json">
      <format>{
        "accountId": "${params.functionParams.accountId}",
        "balance": 5000.00,
        "currency": "USD",
        "lastUpdated": "${formatDateTime(now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}"
      }</format>
    </payloadFactory>
  </sequence>
</template>

<template name="GetTransactionHistoryTool" xmlns="http://ws.apache.org/ns/synapse">
  <description>Retrieves the transaction history for a given account ID</description>
  <parameter isMandatory="true" name="accountId" description="The account ID to get transaction history for"/>
  <sequence>
    <payloadFactory media-type="json">
      <format>{
        "accountId": "${params.functionParams.accountId}",
        "transactions": [
          {
            "transactionId": "TXN001",
            "type": "deposit",
            "amount": 1000.00,
            "date": "2024-01-15"
          },
          {
            "transactionId": "TXN002",
            "type": "withdrawal",
            "amount": 500.00,
            "date": "2024-01-16"
          }
        ]
      }</format>
    </payloadFactory>
  </sequence>
</template>
